Subject: Renewal: proposed reserved GPU expansion & model mix changes

Hi Elaine --

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As Brightline prepares to renew, we reviewed your traffic profile and the model roadmap you shared (long-context summarization + a dedicated reranker for product pages). Those two changes materially shift the serving footprint.

Attached is an initial SOW and a proposed capacity sketch. High level:
- Add two reserved pools (prod-rankers and prod-generation) totaling 8 H100 GPUs (four per pool) to support the 24k-context family and a reranker service.
- Throughput guardrail: 1,200 inference requests/min (at 512 token avg) across the generation pool; reranker pool sized for 2,000 short-context requests/min with <60ms p95 GPU time.
- 12-month term beginning on renewal date; migration credit for first 30 days.

Can you confirm timelines for procurement and whether your legal team needs any additional compliance items? If that looks directionally right I’ll pull in our solutions and engineering leads to size the pools to your exact qps curves.

Best,
Laura Bennett

Laura / team — initial sizing notes attached (capacity_proposal_v1.xlsx). Summary:
- Pools: prod-generation (4x H100) + prod-reranker (4x H100). Rationale: long-context model needs larger GPU memory and the reranker benefits from dedicated short-latency pool.
- Expected steady-state throughput: generation pool 900–1,300 reqs/min at 512 tokens depending on batching; reranker pool 1,800–2,200 calls/min. We sized with 25% headroom for traffic bursts.
- Throughput SLA proposal: 1,200 reqs/min sustained (gen pool) with 99.5% availability; reranker: p95 GPU processing <60ms, 99.7% availability. Credits: sliding scale 5%–25% of monthly committed fee depending on severity.
- Cost delta: +$42,000/month for the reserved 8 H100s (includes platform + support). Migration credit: 20% credit applied to first month if Brightline completes parallel validation within the two-week window.

Operational notes:
- Canary rollout: start with 10% traffic to reranker pool for 72 hours, validate precision/recall vs. baseline dataset.
- KV/prefix cache: we’ll pre-warm using a synthetic workload during the parallel run to reduce cold-start tail latency.

I’ll attach the spreadsheet and a short runbook; Monica — I left placeholders for SLO clauses you should review.

— Vivek

Elaine / team — following internal sizing and your procurement timeline here’s a consolidated proposal and next steps:

What we’re proposing (renewal amendment):
- Commit: 8x H100 reserved GPUs in two named pools (prod-generation: 4x; prod-reranker: 4x).
- Model mix: primary model 24k-context generation family + dedicated reranker binary (inline API) — this is the configuration used in the sizing workbook.
- SLA & credits: as proposed (generation availability 99.5%, reranker p95 GPU <60ms, credit banding included). Monica will circulate the SLA addendum draft separately.
- Term & pricing: 12 months; delta +$42,000/month; migration credit 20% first-month if Brightline completes parallel validation within two weeks of cutover.

Operational steps and timeline:
1) Day 0–3: Legal & procurement review (we’ll stand by for DocuSign).
2) Day 4–10: Provisioning and private network setup; pre-warm caches.
3) Day 11–24: Two-week parallel run with 10% canary, validation tests and dataset checks.
4) Day 25: Full cutover if validation passes.

Links & attachments: SOW attached; DocuSign template is linked here: https://www.docusign.com/templates/rdw-4821-sow

Please let me know if procurement needs any additional line-item breakdown for Finance. If you’re comfortable we’ll prepare the amendment and send for signature tomorrow morning.

Thanks — excited to keep scaling this with you.
